contracts.actual_behavior: The shipped resource definitions are authoritative, independently of unused datagen bootstrap values. Enderitium ore uses size5/discard0/EndStone, placed count8/uniform Y-64..80; Enderstone deposit size64/rarity chance10/same height. Biome addition targets #minecraft:is_end. Desert Bomber biome modifier weight75/group1..4; Chorusling modifier ONLY End highlands/midlands/small islands weight3/group1, with independent spawn rules retained. Ruined pyramid overrides monster list at piece bounds with Bomber weight1/group1. Collapsed kingdom uses mod lm_jigsaw depth40/range300/start0/WORLD_SURFACE_WG/beard_box; station lm_jigsaw depth40/range300/start80/WORLD_SURFACE/none; both full monster overrides empty. Other structures use vanilla jigsaw size1/range30 except Cloudy temple size7/range116. Extra height/predicate/predicates fields on native jigsaw definitions have no corresponding native codec field; no custom terrain gate is inferred from them. Placement spacing/separation/salt and frequency are retained by exact resource paths below; station frequency.75/legacy_type_1. Station exclusion_zone is at structure-set root outside placement, so it is not an argument to RandomSpreadStructurePlacement. All59 template pools use native single_pool_element/rigid and minecraft:empty fallback. The processor list is a top-level array, VALID through pinned StructureProcessorType.DIRECT_CODEC alternative list shape. Kingdom pools reference NO_WATER_PROCESSOR; other pools minecraft:empty. Graph of start_pool, fallback, element location and template jigsaw pool links reaches58/71 templates, with no missing nonempty link. Reachability is only an upper bound: depth, attachment, projection, collision and RNG can reject a piece. The13 unreferenced templates remain directly loadable by ID; no natural producer is inferred merely from archive presence.

contracts.actual_behavior: All76 loot tables (39block/29entity/8chest) and157 recipes reviewed as native acquisition definitions. Loot entries request vanilla items, counts, enchant_with_levels/#minecraft:on_random_loot, ore Fortune and explosion functions; no entity summon, custom damage or status execution. Exact item IDs, weights, counts, conditions and enchant levels remain in resource evidence and input table. All mod item references in recipe/loot/current item tags resolve to native item or block-item registration keys. Entity tables do not supply a type field; native loot context resolution retains its loader behavior. Chest resource variants grant ordinary materials/equipment/food and occasional mod rod, bottles, lanterns, templates/discs; base and luxury station tables intentionally share minecraft:chests/space_station_loot_table_basic random_sequence, which is an RNG stream ID rather than a lookup alias. Cloudy temple enchant levels15..25, book30; kingdom/station equipment20..39. Enderitium ore Silk Touch drops itself; other branch Fortune/apply_bonus plus set_count1..5 and explosion_decay yields gems. Soul Candle loot requests ONE candle regardless of CANDLES state. Recipes use86 shaped/46stonecutting/14smithing_transform/3smelting/8shapeless definitions. Recipe results contain only id/count, no injected attack/effect/data components. Smithing inherits native component transfer; resulting item behavior belongs to the existing exact item contracts, not an independent damage effect.

contracts.display_name: Native structure actor and block-entity payloads
contracts.actual_behavior: All71 compressed native templates have DataVersion3465 and are captured without ordinary-block-coordinate retention, preserving every used palette state, entity, block-entity and nested payload. Pinned StructureTemplateManager runs STRUCTURE data fixing before load. Native single_pool_element placement includes entities and setsFinalizeEntities(true); after transformed position/UUID replacement and NBT entity creation, mobs receive STRUCTURE finalizeSpawn. NeoForge21.1.244 adds processor.processEntity, preserves UUID replacement and conditional finalization; native NoWater processor has no entity override. Thus raw saved minecraft:generic.* attributes, foreign attribute IDs, current Health and copied ForgeCaps are not assertions of final live stats. Constructor/config multipliers, NBT read overrides, registry resolution, data fixing and finalization retain the separately reviewed consumers. Mini/boss finalization writes actual placed spawn position, replacing stale saved source-world coordinates. Raw examples include Ancient Guardian Health170 or200/max200; Frostbitten170 or219.69998/max220; Skeletosaurus149.59997 or150/max150; Shulker Mimic150/180/200 with matching saved max; low health/native sleep/phase/texture flags remain evidence, not an additional attack. All309 entity HandItems are empty; 306 armor arrays empty, five armor stands carry ordinary iron/chainmail. No installed active-effect payload. Native item entity contains Ancient Spike Count1/Health5/PickupDelay0/Age3803/Lifespan6000; owner/age interpretation remains native loading. One annihilation bottle projectile retains Owner UUID/LeftOwner/HasBeenShot; placement replaces its own UUID, not arbitrary owner links. Seven distinct spawner payload variants request Spikebug, Chorusling, Husk, Bomber or Wither Skeleton: MaxNearby6/RequiredPlayerRange16/SpawnCount4/minDelay200/max800/range4; delays0/44/50/142, empty SpawnPotentials and simple SpawnData.entity.id. Server BaseSpawner checks player range, collision, placement/rules, nearby cap and successful additions; simple id-only spawn data selects native finalizeSpawn. No automatic all-at-once spawn follows from SpawnCount. Eighteen trapdoor BEs retain tick and animationTick0; locks/open/part come from palette, animation-running state starts false. Sixteen swinging axes retain world-coordinate scratch/ticks that active ticker recomputes before collision. Two teleport-machine BEs have old a=0 field with no custom load consumer, so active state initializes false. One anchor has palette charges0. Empty dispenser/hopper payloads install no ammunition. Three old chests contain ordinary native inventory including iron gear, SharpnessIII book and enchanted golden apple; all other container behavior follows empty inventory/loot table references. Fourteen actual loot-table IDs, twelve spawners,101 jigsaws and23 unpowered SAVE/CORNER structure blocks are retained; structure-block archive metadata is not an extra automatic placement. Foreign legacy ForgeCaps include inert status/cooldown inventories and gravity direction down/strength1; no Legendary Monsters reader makes them new effects, and the pinned current loader consumes NeoForge attachment keys rather than inventing an old ForgeCaps migration. Foreign installed mods may independently interpret their own data; no dependency effect is attributed to Legendary Monsters. Hazard/capture/entity behaviors reuse canonical contracts; resource copies do not duplicate independent mechanics.
